digest.component_or_area: code-review system criterion-id resolution and pass-through pipeline
propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria are dropped at five seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission

Eight dependent child tickets repair each seam with disjoint file ownership: ids.py, batch_runner/gate_dispatch, workflow_ops, eval_solver/eval, _llm_eval_commands, documentation, corpus configuration, and live Gerrit dogfood
Active project code-review criteria must run once in Round A with retained logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, using repository-effective Pass-3 routing and balanced eval corpus
The runtime contract and extension API for project criteria are documented in docs/llm-framework.md with eval/CLI admission that rejects inactive or ambiguous project ids
